description: Registry of every date in the repository that can stop CI or a service on a calendar day. scripts/qa/dated-obligations-check.ps1 warns when an open item is due within warnDays and fails within failDays, when it is past due, or when its date is not yyyy-MM-dd. An obligation changes only by its status (Closed / Renewed with a different reviewer) and a recorded decision, never by moving the date. DatedObligationsTests fails when a JSON file carries one of the keys below and is neither registered here nor listed as historical.
